# fsync_policy decides when the write-ahead log is forced to disk.
with LedgerLog("__DIRECTORY__", fsync_policy="__POLICY__") as db:
    db.put(b"user:1042:login", b"2026-11-16T05:00:00Z")
    print(db.get(b"user:1042:login"))
